nullable_when: NULL is allowed only when the corresponding *_state is open or unknown; open may represent an unbounded endpoint, but unknown must not imply indefinite validity
valid_values: ISO 8601; from < to; retain the original offset

new_definition_reason: Relationship key, version, provenance, or implementation structure added in S2.2; inherits the purpose of its parent table
value_state_rule: For NULL values, record missing/unknown/invalid/not_applicable/not_mature in provenance_record.value_states or this table's status; preserve observed zero
precision: microsecond; source precision retained
availability_rule: Use the record available_time/known_from; otherwise provenance_record.available_time. Derived values become available only after all selected input versions are available. Validation-only truth is forbidden as an input.
timezone_rule: TIMESTAMPTZ stored in UTC; source zone/offset retained in provenance_record; DATE uses explicitly specified tenant report_timezone. Identifiers and non-temporal fields: not applicable.
frequency: Append a new version on change; daily snapshots can be reconstructed
source_strategy: derived
supply_rule: Work package S23-WP-003, device and driver-vehicle histories, validity periods, and original evidence: allocate vehicles, devices, drivers, and spare devices from a shared schedule; generate source installation, dispatch, session, driving evidence, and corrections before projecting the S2.2 relationship intervals. Core assignment data supplies source facts; store DE-M02 inference results separately in identity_event_assignment, and do not treat a login alone as confirmation of driving. Each valid interval and known interval is half-open; retain original bitemporal versions for late entries and withdrawals. Generate observation windows from deployment status and reporting policy, rather than inferring expected counts from received points. Register counter epochs using explicit reset/ECU replacement evidence; negative differences without evidence remain pending investigation.
planned_stage: S2.4 inputs and configuration; S3 actual analysis/model/validation outputs

new_definition_reason: Relationship key, version, provenance, or implementation structure added in S2.2; inherits the purpose of its parent table
value_state_rule: For NULL values, record missing/unknown/invalid/not_applicable/not_mature in provenance_record.value_states or this table's status; preserve observed zero
precision: UTF-8 or structured JSON; no truncation
availability_rule: Use the record available_time/known_from; otherwise provenance_record.available_time. Derived values become available only after all selected input versions are available. Validation-only truth is forbidden as an input.
timezone_rule: TIMESTAMPTZ stored in UTC; source zone/offset retained in provenance_record; DATE uses explicitly specified tenant report_timezone. Identifiers and non-temporal fields: not applicable.
frequency: Append when an event occurs or is revised
source_strategy: Candidate public context or vendor responses require separate verification; the complete demonstration uses an explicitly synthetic version. Do not backfill real forecasts when historical snapshots have not been obtained
supply_rule: Work package S23-WP-008, optional background data and source matching: the source decision module overrides public-source choices for this package; components without verified acquisition, use, and redistribution rights default to explicitly synthetic or disabled. Join prices by fuel grade, region, unit, currency, and period keys; join weather by geographic distance, time windows, and quality flags, retaining matched/unknown states and matching errors. Do not falsely link separate sources as the same real vehicle, driver, or trip. Public prices/weather provide background only; combinations with project-authored routes or simulated transactions must be explicitly identified as simulated. energy_weather_match contains matches between original background data and synthetic locations, with field_origins tracing both; historical observations must not be treated as forecasts known at the ETA decision time. Disable public historical forecast_available without supporting evidence; synthetic forecasts use independent forecast errors instead of directly revealing latent true weather. Routing uses original demonstration responses and does not claim vendor provenance.
planned_stage: S2.4 inputs and configuration; S3 actual analysis/model/validation outputs

precision: UTF-8 or structured JSON; no truncation
availability_rule: Use the record available_time/known_from; otherwise provenance_record.available_time. Derived values become available only after all selected input versions are available. Validation-only truth is forbidden as an input.
timezone_rule: TIMESTAMPTZ stored in UTC; source zone/offset retained in provenance_record; DATE uses explicitly specified tenant report_timezone. Identifiers and non-temporal fields: not applicable.
frequency: Append when events or status changes occur; derive daily aggregates from snapshots with fixed cutoffs.
source_strategy: Publicly shareable synthetic demonstration data generated for this project; original company records are not required inputs. Public data may provide format context but must not be represented as project events.
supply_rule: Work package S23-WP-010, actual standardized importer processing: future executions perform parser, normalize, and idempotency/revision processing and write actual attempts and field-level results; S2.3 does not generate these outputs. Retain original artifacts; received, rejected, pending resolution, normalized, retransmitted, and withdrawn records have mutually exclusive or explicitly defined statuses and error codes.
planned_stage: S2.4 inputs and configuration; S3 actual analysis/model/validation outputs
